dedupe_keys.name: state of wildfires 2025 26 exposure datasets physical assets population and protected areas

description: These datasets support the State of Wildfires 2025-26 report and summarise, for each fire season from March to February, how much was exposed to wildland fire worldwide, with anomalies for the latest season. The physical asset exposure dataset intersects the LitPop asset layer, which spreads national capital estimates on a 1 km grid using night lights and population, with filtered Global Fire Atlas fire perimeters (version 20260408), giving the value of assets inside burned perimeters; companion datasets give population exposure per fire from WorldPop at about 100 m for 2002 to 2026, and exposure of protected areas from MODIS burned area and the World Database on Protected Areas. They were produced by Carmen Steinmann and Samuel Juhel (ETH Zurich), Matthew Jones (University of East Anglia), Seyd Teymoor Seydi and Mojtaba Sadegh (Boise State) and others in the State of Wildfires community on Zenodo, released June and July 2026. They are accessible as free CSV downloads (13.6 MB for assets) under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: exposure does not imply damage or loss, LitPop values are modelled, not asset inventories, and the report was under review at Earth System Science Data. They support wildfire hazard exposure analysis and trend monitoring for infrastructure and settlements; related records are EFFIS, CLIMADA and the WDPA.
